paper_citation: Johan Bratberg, Bo Jansson, Thermodynamic evaluation of the C−Co−W−Hf−Zr system for cemented carbides applications, JPED 27, 213-219 (2006).
quote: Dmitrieva and Shurin[21] have also measured the invariant melting temperature for the C-Co-Hf and C-Co-Zr systems. They found much higher temperatures, 1400 °C for the C-Co-Hf system and 1370 °C for the C-Co-Zr system, which are probably caused by inhomogeneous samples because they where cast.
